subject: Private VPC deployment — control & data validation and action log
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: infra@acmecloud.com, netops@telco.example.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private VPC deployment — control & data validation and action log

Hi team,

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, I'm attaching the latest schematic (acme-private-vpc-arch-v2.pdf) and a short control/data contracts spreadsheet. We need to validate three items before we sign off on the on-prem handoff:

- Control-plane connectivity: TLS endpoints, cert propagation path, and whether we rely on mutual TLS or customer-managed KMS for auth.
- Data-plane egress constraints: approved NAT ranges, BGP peering expectations, and allowed external destinations.
- Observability proof: what telemetry (span logs/metrics) needs to flow into our hosted console vs customer-managed observability.

Please respond in-thread with clear owners and ETA per line item. I'll compile action log and evidence bundle for the onboarding checklist.

Attachments: acme-private-vpc-arch-v2.pdf, controlplane-data-contracts.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
From: Infra Team (Acme Cloud) <infra@acmecloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, netops@telco.example.com
Date: 2026-07-11T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC deployment — control & data validation and action log

Kim — thanks for the doc. Quick answers and owners below (we'll attach config snippets by EOD):

- Control-plane connectivity (owner: Acme Infra - Priya): we prefer mTLS between Redwood control endpoints and our control-plane gateway. We can accept customer-managed certs (via our ACME endpoint) or Redwood's cert bundle; customer policy prefers using our KMS as the root of trust. ETA for config snippets: 2026-07-12 17:00 PT.

- Data-plane egress (owner: Telco NetOps - Sam): BGP peering will advertise the /24 service CIDR and we will NAT to the customer egress IP ranges. We require static outbound allowlist for 3 token endpoints and two metrics collectors — ranges listed in the spreadsheet. We'll provide BGP ASN and community tags in the config snippet.

- Observability (owner: Acme SRE - Lina): we'll forward a subset of telemetry (request traces + error rates) to Redwood's ingest endpoint over TLS; full packet-level telemetry remains on-prem. We'll provide a mapping file of metrics and retention.

We'll reply in-thread with attachments and config snippets later today.

— Acme Infra
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Acme Infra <infra@acmecloud.com>, netops@telco.example.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC deployment — control & data validation and action log

Adding Ops perspective and small clarifying asks:

- Can Acme confirm whether they will terminate TLS at their edge (we need certificate chain to validate control-plane health probes)?
- Jonas/Ben: we need a runbook stub for token rotation and emergency rollback (what's the expected RTO if the control channel drops?).

I'll take the runbook as an action. Proposed owners/ETAs:
- Cert chain + ACME process: Acme Infra — 2026-07-12 17:00 PT
- Runbook stub (token rotation + rollback): Marissa Cole (ops) — 2026-07-13 12:00 PT
- BGP snippet + NAT config: Telco NetOps — 2026-07-12 17:00 PT

If anything is time-sensitive for procurement (contracts team), flag it and I'll escalate.

Marissa
Director, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Acme Infra <infra@acmecloud.com>, netops@telco.example.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC deployment — control & data validation and action log

Thanks — following up with a short technical checklist I'll own for deployment acceptance testing (DAT):

1) Control-plane health: mutual TLS handshake success across 10 consecutive probes; cert chain present in logs (owner: Jonas) — due 2026-07-13 09:00 PT.
2) KV cache isolation verification: ensure customer tenant's KV keys are not visible in multi-tenant telemetry (owner: Ben) — due 2026-07-13 11:00 PT.
3) Egress proof: sample pcap and NAT translation table confirming outbound mapping for token endpoints (owner: Telco NetOps) — due 2026-07-13 12:00 PT.
4) Observability mapping: list of metric names and retention windows forwarded to Redwood (owner: Acme SRE) — due 2026-07-12 17:00 PT.

I'll run the DAT checklist and post results to the drive link once items are collected. If any acceptance item fails, we will hold the cutover and log remediation steps.

Jonas
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
From: Infra Team (Acme Cloud) <infra@acmecloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, netops@telco.example.com
Date: 2026-07-13T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC deployment — control & data validation and action log

Kimberly / team — delivering the promised artifacts. See attached zip (evidence-logs-20260713.zip) which contains:

- cert-chain-acme.pem (shows ACME root and intermediate certs)
- bgp-config-snippet.txt (ASN + community tags)
- nat-translation-sample.pcap (sample traffic with NAT mapping)
- metrics-mapping.csv (list of metrics forwarded to Redwood)
- onboarding-checklist-signed.pdf (customer sign-off for preflight)

Quick notes:
- We terminated TLS at our edge and will forward mTLS to Redwood control endpoints using our ACME-managed certs. We documented the ACME renewal cadence in cert-chain-acme.pem metadata.
- BGP session was tested in lab; ASN and community tags are listed in bgp-config-snippet.txt.
- We ran a simulated token-rotation test in staging; details are in the runbook folder inside the zip.

Next steps (agreed):
- Redwood Ops (Marissa) to validate runbook and provide emergency rollback instructions (ETA 2026-07-13 20:00 PT).
- Jonas to run DAT and report pass/fail (ETA 2026-07-14 09:00 PT).
- Kimberly to confirm contractual egress acceptances for procurement (if anything changes we need an SLA exception).

Thanks — we'll stand by for acceptance results.

— Acme Infra
